# MediaPipe Hands runtime

Pinned package: `@mediapipe/hands@0.4.1675469240`

Runtime files in this directory are localized from the pinned npm package so
gesture mode does not depend on a CDN at runtime. Per-file source URLs, sizes,
and SHA-256 digests are recorded in `../../../assets/asset-manifest.json`.
